storyline.real: Montoya leads from the start until Schumacher goes for the lead at turn 2 on lap 16 and both run off the road, which hands Barrichello the lead. Coulthard, up from seventh on the grid, has saved fuel: he stops three laps after Barrichello, comes out ahead and wins by 2.19 s. Ferrari have Barrichello give second to Schumacher at the last corner.

eras.briefing: A1-Ring, 2001. Schumacher started on pole and Coulthard seventh. You run Coulthard, second after 44 laps, a second behind Barrichello with Schumacher right behind you, and none of the three has stopped. You saved fuel early: stay out longer than the Ferrari and win.
